title: CSKA capture fourth consecutive title
description: Khimky - CSKA 69-99 CSKA earned the VTB League title. They coasted past Khimky on the road to complete the sweep of the championship series. CSKA led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They shot 63.3 percent from the field and made 26-of-30 free shots (86.7 percent) during the game, while Khimky only scored seven points from the stripe. They outrebounded Khimky 36-20 including a 30-11 advantage in defensive rebounds. It was a great shooting night for CSKA especially from behind the arc, where they had solid 61.1 percentage. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 26 assists. Great defensive blocking was one of the keys in this match when CSKA made 7 blocks. 27 personal fouls committed by Khimky helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities.
